summary: 抢先体验的星球经营模拟。开发者披露 AI 工具用于语法校对、排查缺陷，以及把文本本地化成不同语言。
reviewNote: 核查 Steam 英文商店页完整 AI 披露、身份（开发商 Denis, Lucas）与英文讨论区首页（可见 15 个主题，总数 56），首页没有与 AI 使用直接相关的主题，未逐帖展开。本款单独检索公开报道 1 次、登记 3 条结果，读取 1 篇原始来源（第三方下载站页面逐字转载了商店页的 AI 披露文本，只能作为披露措辞与存在的时间戳旁证）。领域判定全部来自商店披露原文，结论基于开发者自述，未经独立审计。 本作处于抢先体验阶段。
description: 官方披露只提到 AI 参与校对、找 bug 与多语言本地化，未说明内容创作领域。

english.summary: An Early Access planet management simulation. The developer states AI-powered tools were used to proofread grammar, hunt for bugs and localise the text into different languages.
english.reviewNote: Reviewed the full English Steam AI disclosure, the identity (developer Denis, Lucas) and the English discussion homepage (15 visible topics of 56); no homepage topic directly concerns AI use and individual threads were not opened. This title was searched 1 time with 3 results and 1 raw source(s) were read. Every area finding comes from the store disclosure text itself and rests on the developer's own statement, without an independent audit. The game is in Early Access.
